overlayEntry.notes: Measured on BNB Chain at pinned block 112517992 (2026-07-27T22:57:31Z, hash 0xc68417d2a0ff3b2bb6fe650832259fd0e1f3cc1f8fdc6a062f14a3fae31e429d) via bsc-rpc.publicnode.com; journaled in the wave-8 packet draft journal 2026-07-27-block-112517992.json. USDF totalSupply() = 111,986,088.07905471; the USDFEarn mint contract (0xc271fc70...) held 0 USDT at the pinned block, consistent with the documented sweep of mint proceeds to Aster's Ceffu custodial account. Aster's documentation describes the delta-neutral strategy (spot purchases on Binance hedged with perpetual shorts via Ceffu MirrorX off-exchange settlement) only qualitatively: no reconciled hedge notionals or net delta, no exchange margin balances or maintenance requirements, and no insurance or loss-absorption fund are published, and no transparency/attestation API or reserve dashboard for USDF exists (searched asterdex.com, docs.asterdex.com, and Ceffu public surfaces), so all three sdn metrics are honestly unavailable. No overlay component is graded: the issuer publishes no itemized custody, venue, or reconciliation figures, so the evidence does not reach the D3 limited class (issuer-published structured data corroborated by an external anchor) for venueAndCustody, and all other components likewise lack itemized evidence; naming Ceffu/MirrorX in prose is a named-third-party anchor but without any itemized issuer data it is not admitted. All six components remain bounded-unknown rather than graded weak.
